results.source_text:
ここからは、日々を自分で組み立てる。
ゴールは下段の『物語を進める』——カードに出ている条件（陥落度など）を満たせば、物語の続きが始まる。
そのために、昼に稼ぎ、夜に堕とす。
results.reference:
From here on, you organize each day yourself.
The goal is 'Advance Story' at the bottom—satisfying card conditions (such as corruption) begins the next part of the story.
To that end, earn by day and corrupt by night.
results.target_text:
From here, assemble your own day.
The goal is to meet the conditions on the card (e.g., degradation).
For that reason, earn at lunch and fall at night.
results.placeholder_details: All tokens and newlines preserved intact
results.evaluator_notes: Newlines preserved. '昼に稼ぎ、夜に堕とす' translated as 'earn at lunch and fall at night'.

results.source_text:
【昼の稼ぎ】上段の3枚だ。
『探索』は果実・素材・遭遇の主軸。『釣り』は安全に食料を稼ぐ（戦闘なし）。果実は催眠の燃料、食料は皆の命綱——毎朝、自分と従えた女たちの食事で減っていく。
『男を狩る』は罠の一発勝負。仕留めれば脅威度が下がり、夜襲されにくくなる。
霧の奥では、彼女たちとの遭遇も、男や獣の乱入もある。
results.reference:
[Daytime Earnings] The top 3 cards.
'Explore' is the core source of fruit, materials, and encounters. 'Fish' gathers food safely without combat. Fruit fuels hypnosis; food is everyone's lifeline—depleted each morning by rations for yourself and subordinated women.
'Hunt Men' is a one-shot trap gambit. Taking them down lowers threat, reducing night raids.
In the deep mist, you may encounter the girls, or face ambushes by men and beasts.
results.target_text:
【Lunch】It is a top 3 piece.
The main axis of fruit, material and encounter. “Fiを” safely earns food (no combat). The fruit is hypnotic fuel, food is the lifeline of everyone — every morning, it is reduced by the diet of the woman who has followed him.
"Hunting a man" is a 罠. Threat is lowered and it is difficult to attack at night.
In the back of the fog, there are encounters with them, and the turbulence of the man and the beast.

results.evaluator_notes: Newlines preserved. Untranslated kana remnants (罠, Fiを) and mistranslation of Explore/Fish.

results.source_text:
『休む』でも『隣で眠る』でも1日が終わり、朝には体力が全回復する。
違いはひとつ——『隣で眠る』は、その日いちども催眠を使わなかった夜にだけ選べる。
力を使った日はひとりで眠れ。我慢した夜の添い寝は、重ねるほど彼女の心との距離を変えていく。
昼の行動（探索/釣り/狩り）は1日3回まで。催眠は1人につき一晩1回。
※左上のメーターにカーソルを乗せると、各数値の説明が出る。
results.reference:
Whether you 'Rest' or 'Sleep Beside Her', the day ends and HP fully restores by morning.
There is one difference—'Sleep Beside Her' can only be chosen on nights you used no hypnosis.
Sleep alone on days you used your power. Restraining yourself and sleeping beside her gradually closes the distance between your hearts.
Daytime actions (Explore/Fish/Hunt) are limited to 3 per day. Hypnosis is limited to once per girl each night.
* Hovering over the top-left meter displays explanations for each stat.
results.target_text:
Even if you rest or sleep next to you, the day ends, and the physical strength will be restored in the morning.
The difference is one—the “sleeping next door” you can choose only at night when you don’t use hypnotic sleep.
I can sleep alone. The reason why I was forced to sleep is to change the distance with her heart.
Daytime action (exploration/fishing/fishing) up to 3 times a day. 1 night per person.
* When you put the cursor on the upper-left meter, the description of each number will appear.

results.evaluator_notes: Newlines and bullet point (*) preserved. Awkward phrasing of co-sleeping rules.

results.source_text:
【守りと人手】夜襲は、脅威度とバレ度が高いほど来る。守りは『拠点を強化』と『島の女たちの配置』だ。
『島の女たちの配置』で浜の女を従えれば（果実2・侵食+2）、採取・防衛・見張りの人手になる。
——ただし従えた数だけ夜ごとにバレ度が滲み、守りが薄い夜襲では連れ去られる。
そして、迎えの船は確実に近づいている。左上の残り日数が尽きる前に、ぜんぶ決めろ。
results.reference:
[Defense & Manpower] Night raids occur more frequently the higher threat and suspicion rise. Defense consists of 'Fortify Camp' and 'Assign Island Women'.
Subordinating beach women through assignment (Fruit 2, Corruption +2) provides labor for gathering, defense, and watch duty.
—However, suspicion seeps out each night for each subordinate, and weak defenses risk them being kidnapped during raids.
Meanwhile, the rescue ship steadily approaches. Settle everything before remaining days run out.
results.target_text:
[Monstering and Human Hands] Night attack comes as high as the level of threat and ballet. “Reinforcement of Locations” and “Placement of Island Women”
If you follow the beach woman with the arrangement of the island women (fr。 2, erosion + 2), it becomes a person of collection, defense, and view.
——However, only the number of守り will be blewed at every night, and it will be taken away by a thin night attack.
The ship is sure to pick up. Before the number of days left is exhausted.

目を見つめた瞬間——彼女の『心の声』が聞こえはじめた。
画面下のセリフがそれだ。心は【隙】【平静】【抵抗】の間で揺れ動き、
セリフの調子が、いまの心を読むヒントになる。
results.reference:
The moment you meet her gaze—her 'inner voice' begins to be heard.
That is the dialogue at the bottom of the screen. Her mind wavers between [Opening], [Calm], and [Resistance],
and the tone of her dialogue provides hints to read her current mental state.
results.target_text:
The moment to look at the eyes—the voice of the heart began to hear.
It is the serif under the screen. The mind is the swaying movement between [Sky] [Sky] [Resis ],
The serif tone is a hint of reading your mind.
